metadata.description: Complete taxonomy of all unique fields found across Mexican customs import document PDFs

pedimento.label: Pedimento (Customs Declaration)
pedimento.description: Official Mexican customs import/export declaration filed with SAT/Aduana

concepto.description: Tax concept (DTA, PRV, IVA, IVA PRV, CC)

identificadores.description: Complementary ID codes (ED=e-document, CS, IC, CR)

vucem_acuse_digitalizacion.label: VUCEM Acuse Digitalización de Documentos
vucem_acuse_digitalizacion.description: Digital document registration receipt from VUCEM portal

bill_of_lading.label: Bill of Lading / Sea Waybill
bill_of_lading.description: Ocean transport document issued by shipping carrier

delivery_order.label: Delivery Order (BL Revalidado)
delivery_order.description: Revalidated B/L for cargo release at destination port

commercial_invoice.label: Commercial Invoice (Factura Comercial)
commercial_invoice.description: Seller's invoice for goods sold internationally

packing_list.label: Packing List (Lista de Empaque)
packing_list.description: Detailed packing specifications of shipped goods

carta_encomienda.label: Carta Encomienda
carta_encomienda.description: Letter delegating customs clearance rights to customs agent

numero_bl.description: Bill of Lading number being delegated

carta_3_1_8.label: Carta 3.1.8 (Value Declaration Letter)
carta_3_1_8.description: Importer's declaration of commercial value per Regla 3.1.8

manifestacion_de_valor.label: Manifestación de Valor
manifestacion_de_valor.description: Official SAT value declaration form for customs valuation

certificado_produccion.label: Certificado de Producción
certificado_produccion.description: Producer's certificate confirming goods origin and specifications

certificado_calidad.label: Certificado de Calidad (Quality Certificate)
certificado_calidad.description: Steel mill quality certificate with chemical and mechanical properties

certificate_of_analysis.label: Certificate of Analysis (COA)
certificate_of_analysis.description: Trader/manufacturer analysis report of chemical product quality

factory_coa.label: Factory Certificate of Analysis (Chinese)
factory_coa.description: Original factory quality inspection report from manufacturer

cargo_insurance.label: Cargo Transportation Insurance Policy
cargo_insurance.description: Marine cargo insurance policy covering goods in transit

equipment_interchange_receipt.label: Equipment Interchange Receipt (EIR)
equipment_interchange_receipt.description: Container return/interchange document at port terminal

servicio.description: Service type (e.g. Recepcion de Contenedor Vacío)

codigos_dano.description: Damage codes: PI=Hundido, PO=Abombado, D=Abollado, SC=Raspado, C=Cortado, H=Perforado, B=Doblado, MN=Desprendido, BR=Roto, L=Flojo, DT=Torsion, CR=Rajado, M=Falta, R=Oxidado, DY=Sucio, IR=Rep.Impropia

aviso_automatico_importacion.label: Aviso Automático de Importación
aviso_automatico_importacion.description: Automatic import permit from Secretaría de Economía for controlled goods

carta_instrucciones.label: Carta de Instrucciones Importación
carta_instrucciones.description: Importer's instruction sheet for customs agent with shipment details

cove_informacion_valor.label: COVE - Información de Valor y de Comercialización
cove_informacion_valor.description: VUCEM electronic value and trade information declaration

checklist_documentos.label: Check List de Documentos de Comercio Exterior
checklist_documentos.description: Document checklist for customs agent verifying required paperwork
